property_summary: For every callee contract that does NOT revert on a low-level call, C.forward(callee, data) always returns (does not revert) and thus the call to callee is observed by a recorder; the mutant that unconditionally calls address(0) can revert and thus break this observability (some inputs lead the reference to succeed while the mutant reverts).
change_summary: Replace the call expression with a guaranteed-failing call by calling a zero address, causing the call to revert and thus forward to revert when previously it might have succeeded.
